findings.summary: Product fields marked Required lack programmatic required state, so assistive technology may not expose them as required controls.
findings.fix: Add the native required attribute to each required product input, select and textarea. In ImageField, apply required to the active file or URL input.
findings.evidence: The labels display “Required,” but the controls have no required attribute.

findings.summary: The form focuses the first invalid control before React renders its error description, so screen readers may not announce the new error on focus.
findings.fix: Move focus after the error state has rendered, such as in an effect keyed to the submitted errors.

findings.summary: A URL preview error sets the URL input invalid but does not associate the error text with that input.
findings.fix: Set aria-describedby to feature-image-error when either error or imageError is present.
findings.evidence: aria-invalid checks error || imageError, while aria-describedby checks only error.

findings.summary: The file input does not programmatically receive the visible accepted-format instructions.
findings.fix: Give the accepted-format instruction an id and reference it from the file input with aria-describedby.
findings.evidence: The file input has accepted formats but no aria-describedby for the visible instructions.
